_comment: Individual records that live research disproved, so they must stop being published. Nothing here is deleted: the row is quarantined and archived, keeping its history and inbound links.
_rules: A record is retired only when the awarding body's own page contradicts the record, or when it duplicates another row for the same programme. Uncertainty is never grounds for retirement.

Host-level retirement cannot cover these cases. One host legitimately carries several programmes - studyinjapan.go.jp serves the seven MEXT scholarship types plus a USA-only edition - so a single row among them can be wrong while its neighbours are correct.
The reason and the successor are stored on the record, so an applicant who followed an old link finds an explanation rather than a dead page.
flag values: DEAD, RENAMED, DUPLICATE, MISATTRIBUTED, NEVER-EXISTED, WRONG-DATA, RETIRED-SUCCESSOR.
